answer: A datacenter or proxy pool as a result cannot mint a fleet in one epoch however much capital it holds, since every identity consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. The plume cap is policed at intake and tide exposes the per-origin counts. At most 1 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a knoll tag. That is 32 dollars per alias. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
